preconditions.description: The number of ribbons (n) is between 1 and 750 inclusive.
Each greeting is a non-empty string composed of 'a' and 'b'.
The total length of all greetings does not exceed 10,000,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The first line of output (max_size) is the size of the largest stylish set.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= idx <= n for idx in selected_indices)
postconditions.description: The second line contains indices of ribbons (1-based) from the input.

postconditions.expression: max_size == len(selected_indices) and all(not is_substring(greetings[i-1], greetings[j-1]) and not is_substring(greetings[j-1], greetings[i-1]) for i in selected_indices for j in selected_indices if i != j)
postconditions.description: The selected ribbons form a stylish set: no greeting is a substring of another in the set.

postconditions.expression: max_size == len(selected_indices) and not exists(larger_set) and all(not is_substring(greetings[i-1], greetings[j-1]) and not is_substring(greetings[j-1], greetings[i-1]) for i in larger_set for j in larger_set if i != j)
postconditions.description: The selected set is maximal in size: no larger stylish set exists.
